summary: Vehicle machine guns, autocannon and AA guns elevate onto their targets, door guns swing out, every round kicks the gun on its mount, and 25-30 mm cannon fire like cannon.
stage: mounted-guns (tools/showcase/stages.json): tests/fixtures/mounted-gun-clips.tscn, showroom battlefield seed 712, fixed 30 Hz, Forward+
